final_draft.answer: No. A live check of our production AWS account (111122223333) on 2026-11-17 found that new EBS disks are not encrypted by default in us-east-1.
final_draft.note: The live check disagrees with the approved answer, so please review this before sending. But a live check run at 2026-11-17T01:12:12Z (evidence:360301e7-5c04-4d8e-9113-fbd9e7fa7fa2) found default EBS encryption switched off in us-east-1. I didn't reuse the approved 'Yes' because the current setting contradicts it. The approved-answer owner should either turn on default encryption (and confirm whether other regions need it too) or update the approved answer. The check only looked at us-east-1, and I don't know the setting in any other region.
